methodology.runtime: fresh process per sample; elapsed compare_paths or summarize_paths call; excludes init, search, input encoding, JS result parsing, and file writes
methodology.wasm_mib: linear-memory capacity after completion; 1 MiB=1048576 bytes
methodology.peak_rss_mib: child process peak RSS, including V8 and JS; excludes parent verifier process
methodology.before: full browser API before this investigation
methodology.after: full compatible API and browser summary API after this investigation
methodology.scaling_fixture: synthetic two-hop graph with 999 distinct n^a*m^b certificates; independently checked partial-order counts

native_stage_samples.notes: temporary native phase timers, removed afterward; separate runs, so values must not be added together

renderer_probe.methodology: Renderer-only actual registry geometry, all labels, 120 pan frames; excludes production interactions and native DOM memory. Slow: 1.6Mbps, 150ms latency, 4x main-thread CPU; headless Chromium.

browser_audit.methodology: Actual UI with real workers. Worker event timestamps are distinct from final rendered waits. Slow: 1.6Mbps,150ms latency,4x main-thread CPU; worker CPU is not throttled.

coverage.methodology: LLVM coverage; new lines from whitespace-insensitive diff against pre-investigation snapshots. Polynomial module has complete line coverage.

engineering_stage0_pilot.source_state: working tree SVG preparation; dirty-state and source fingerprints in source-verification.json.gz
engineering_stage0_pilot.refresh_rate_note: headless rAF cadence is recorded; physical display refresh not measured
engineering_stage0_pilot.gating: informational; no stable CI variance or tail estimate established
limitations: rAF cadence is not handler/render cost or input-to-presentation latency
first pan/drag sample uses first pointermove; pointerdown latency is not measured
ten-run nearest-rank p95 is the maximum, not a stable tail estimate
DOM marks do not certify visible pixels or startup-input responsiveness
page heap is rounded/nonstandard; worker heap and process RSS not measured
no physical mobile, manual screen reader, cross-engine or CI variance acceptance yet

interaction_environment.event_timing_scope: discrete events at durationThreshold=16 ms, quantized durations; continuous wheel/move not covered; absent entries are not zero latency
interaction_environment.gating: informational; no stable CI variance or tail estimate established

cold_environment.playwright_chromium_path: /Users/xiweipan/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium-1208/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing

cold_measurement_scope.paint_proxy: two rAF callbacks after DOM readiness; fullReady also requires three stable camera samples and loaded fonts, not physical pixels
cold_measurement_scope.startup_input: Playwright fill-to-suggestion round trip; includes automation overhead; comparison_done_at_input records whether it overlapped startup
cold_measurement_scope.warm_query: input/keydown handler observation to suggestion/comparison DOM readiness; excludes presentation and OS input delay
cold_measurement_scope.memory: 50 ms polling: sampled peak Chromium RSS sum (may double count shared pages), sampled main-page JS heap, final WASM linear capacity; excludes unsampled peaks
cold_measurement_scope.trace: union of matching slices per thread up to readiness; missing categories unavailable; not per-frame render cost

engineering_stage0_frame_costs.sample_unit: independent traced run; each run has separate active-frame samples
engineering_stage0_frame_costs.scope: union of named main-thread script/style/layout/prepaint/paint/compositing slices; includes instrumentation, excludes GPU/raster threads and unclassified work
engineering_stage0_frame_costs.gating: informational; no calibrated CI margin or stable tail estimate

invalid_batch.reason: Website verification tests overlapped approximately the final five seconds; excluded from timing conclusions
